summary: Thin wrapper around the Win32 GlobalMemoryStatus API: initializes a local _MEMORYSTATUS buffer with dwLength = 32 (the struct size) and calls GlobalMemoryStatus(&Buffer), discarding the results. Called by RenderUISystemGlobalInit during UI-system global initialization.

operations.description: Initialize Buffer.dwLength = 32 so the kernel fills the full _MEMORYSTATUS structure.
Call GlobalMemoryStatus(&Buffer) through the imported function pointer at global 0x0059E244.
Return void after the call; the memory-status data is not used by this function.
Called by RenderUISystemGlobalInit (0x0053C360) during global UI-system initialization.
